This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of 5 [[stellated truncated hexahedron|stellated truncated hexahedra]], formed by star-truncating each of the cubes in the [[compound of five cubes|compound of 5 cubes]].

== Cartesian coordinates ==
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of this compound are all the cyclic permutations of

: (±(2−{{radic|2}}), ±{{radic|2}}, ±(2−{{radic|2}}))
: (±φ, ±(φ<sup>−1</sup>−φ<sup>−1</sup>{{radic|2}}), ±(2φ−1−φ{{radic|2}}))
: (±1, ±(φ<sup>−2</sup>+φ<sup>−1</sup>{{radic|2}}), ±(φ<sup>2</sup>−φ{{radic|2}}))
: (±(1−{{radic|2}}), ±(−φ<sup>−2</sup>+{{radic|2}}), ±(φ<sup>2</sup>−{{radic|2}}))
: (±(φ−φ{{radic|2}}), ±(−φ<sup>−1</sup>), ±(2φ−1−φ<sup>−1</sup>{{radic|2}}))

where φ = (1+{{radic|5}})/2 is the [[golden ratio]].
